title: A team can still be assigned through the API while Team Assignment is off
label: BUG vs ZOHO
env: TAVI staging-desk.taviportal.com (NDC-Staging, owner) · Dept QA AS6 Dept A, team QA AS6 Team A · Zoho Desk org techsolutionsegypt (Enterprise trial, admin), dept Haytham Mohamed

panels.caption: TAVI: Setup → Assignment Rules → Team Assignment, QA AS6 Dept A switched OFF
TAVI: ticket #1189 after POST /desk/tickets/{id}/assign {team_id} (200) — owner QA AS6 Team A
Zoho: Setup → Teams → "Team Assignment" switch per department (shown ON; its tooltip reads "Click to disallow ticket and activity assignment to teams")

rows: One "Team Assignment" switch per department; its tooltip says it allows or disallows ticket and activity assignment to teams (seen).
Same single switch per department, with help text "Off: only agents can be chosen." With it off, the ticket owner picker shows only Agents (correct).
Assigning a team while the switch is off
Not allowed: with Team Assignment off, tickets cannot be assigned to teams (Zoho tooltip, seen). What Zoho's API returns in this state was not checked.

With Dept A switch OFF, POST /desk/tickets/{id}/assign with team_id returned 200 and ticket #1189 was assigned to QA AS6 Team A. New rules with a team target are refused correctly (team_assignment_off), so only this API path lets it through.
